architecture_rule: Keep the existing chosen-actor dispatch relation as a primitive and add actor-priority eligibility as a separate production layer. Do not silently change the meaning of existing theorems.
claim_guardrails: Do not say DTR is single-actor; the global formal model contains multiple actor instances.
Do not conflate the current one-main-actor parser bridge with the multi-actor DTR formal model.
Do not claim full actor-priority equivalence until source eligibility, target ordering, translation, and bidirectional scheduler-choice correspondence pass.
Do not require a literal actor-priority field when an equivalent compiled ordering mechanism is proved.
Do not erase actor ordering in a priority-discriminating simultaneous-actor case.
